apia-1.name: Mount Vaea
apia-1.coordinates_source: OSM way 188045332 highway=footway 'Robert Louis Stevenson Tomb Long Trail' (2205 m), midpoint by length; resolve-pin.py returned LOW (no feature), so taken from the Overpass trail geometry. 665 m from placement point (Wikipedia summit point).
apia-1.ticketUrl_reason: Free public walk to the tomb; no operator. The adjacent RLS Museum is a separate spot (apia-2).

facts.fact: 472 m summit overlooking Apia, about 3 km inland of the town and harbour
Robert Louis Stevenson's grave is at the top, with views east and across the Pacific
The longer, shallower path takes about an hour and is easy; the steeper path is an option if dry; take water
No charge to climb to the grave

apia-1.bio_suggestion: A walk of about an hour up a 472 m summit above Apia to Robert Louis Stevenson's grave, with views east over the Pacific.
apia-1.notes: Free per Wikivoyage (updated Jan 2016); unverified since.

apia-6.name: Samoa Cultural Village
apia-6.coordinates_source: LOW: no OSM/Wikipedia feature. Decoded Google plus code 569M+HHP (Beach Rd, Apia) from the Airial listing; agrees within ~40 m with the Samoa Tourism Authority Visitor Information Fale (Wikivoyage Apia -13.8314,-171.7662). 666 m from the placement hint. Owner may want a map check.
apia-6.ticketUrl_note: Operator is the Samoa Tourism Authority (info@samoa.travel); samoa.travel returned 403 to scripts. No deep link found; check in a real browser.

facts.fact: Ceremonies, rituals, songs, dances and workshops show Samoan customs; participation is free, donations accepted
Address Beach Rd, Apia; contact info@samoa.travel
Show with dances, umu cooking, kava ceremony and crafts (about three hours, listing says 20 tala; conflicts with free)

apia-6.bio_suggestion: A Beach Road cultural centre in Apia with songs, dances, umu cooking, kava ceremonies and craft workshops.
apia-6.notes: Price conflict: ArrivalGuides says free with donations, Airial says 20 WST. Neither is official; unverified. Hours conflict and are not recorded. Weekday-only operation per ArrivalGuides is a bio/tips matter.

papapapai-tai-falls.name: Papapapai-tai Falls
papapapai-tai-falls.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint 'Papapapaitai-falls' (Nominatim), MEDIUM; Wikivoyage listing -13.942896,-171.775908 within 50 m. resolve-pin.py itself found nothing (name spelling). Moved 1.6 m from placement.

facts.fact: A 100 m drop, near the north-south road 2 km south of the Lanoto'o turn-off
Tallest waterfall in Samoa, seen from a viewing area on the Cross Island Road
Primarily a viewing experience, not a swim spot

papapapai-tai-falls.bio_suggestion: Samoa's tallest waterfall, a roughly 100 m drop seen from a roadside viewing area on the Cross Island Road.
papapapai-tai-falls.notes: Fee: search results conflict (a guide says no fee; others say small fee at community sites generally). The viewpoint appears free; unverified.

return-to-paradise-beach.name: Return to Paradise Beach
return-to-paradise-beach.coordinates_source: resolve-pin.py HIGH: OSM tourism=attraction 'Return To Paradise Beach' (two matches); 44 m from placement point (OSM natural=beach).
return-to-paradise-beach.ticketUrl_reason: Public beach; the Return to Paradise Resort next door is a different business.

facts.fact: Southwest coast near Lefaga; a beautiful beach
Filmed here for the 1953 film Return to Paradise starring Gary Cooper, written by James Michener

return-to-paradise-beach.bio_suggestion: A beach near Lefaga on the south-west coast where the 1953 film Return to Paradise, with Gary Cooper, was shot.
return-to-paradise-beach.notes: UNVERIFIED: no source states an access fee (Wikivoyage price field blank). Samoan beaches are often village-managed and may charge; the owner should confirm.

savaii-4.name: Afu Aau Falls
savaii-4.coordinates_source: LOW from resolve-pin.py (no OSM feature). Wikidata Q31866642 P625 (-13.744167,-172.313889) and Wikivoyage listing (-13.74698,-172.312625) agree within ~350 m; used Wikidata. Plizio gives -13.7832,-172.2751 (5 km off) and was rejected. Needs a map check of the entrance fale.
savaii-4.ticketUrl_reason: Community-run (family collects the fee at an entrance fale); no official site found.

facts.fact: Also called Olemoe Falls; the most spectacular of Savai'i's jungle waterfalls, a half-hour walk from a 4WD track
Spring-fed waterhole about 3 m deep, swimming possible in the dry season; pay at the fale by the entrance
Signposted on the South Coast Road about 12 km from Salelologa; entry fee collected at the entrance fale; short maintained trail

savaii-4.bio_suggestion: A spring-fed jungle waterfall on Savai'i's south coast, with a swimming hole a short walk from the entrance fale.
savaii-4.notes: Fee unverified: blogs report 5 tala per person (International Traveller, hikingtheworld search) and 10 tala (Wanderlog, Trip.com reviewer); no official source. Wikivoyage's half-hour walk conflicts with hikingtheworld's 300 m trail.

savaii-9.name: Paia Dwarfs Cave
savaii-9.coordinates_source: resolve-pin.py HIGH: OSM tourism=attraction 'Paia Dwarfs cave' (Nominatim); 1570 m from the Wikivoyage listing geo tag, which is the village-area point.

facts.fact: Lava tube over a kilometre long in the north-east near Paia; legend says dwarves live there and its end has never been reached
A guide from Paia village is essential and exploring can take almost a day
Guides are the village matai or local boys; the cave crosses underground rivers

savaii-9.bio_suggestion: A lava tube over a kilometre long near Paia village, explored with a local guide, said in legend to be home to dwarves.
savaii-9.notes: Guide fee unverified: 5-10 WST (travel blog) vs ST20 (Samoa Observer); neither official. needs: none (guide fee is the price).

unresolved: Return to Paradise Beach fee unverified
